business: Margino (مارژینو - نرم‌افزار هوش رقبا و قیمت‌گذاری خودکار ووکامرس)
target: Iranian independent e-commerce store owners running WooCommerce stores selling buy-and-resell products (perfume, cosmetics, silver accessories, electronics)
where: Iran (Tehran, Isfahan, Mashhad, Shiraz, Tabriz, and provincial cities)

behaviours.name: Margin-conscious survivor
behaviours.how: Got burned previously when USD surged and sold inventory below replacement cost; anxious about restocking.

behaviours.name: Torob rank-obsessed
behaviours.how: Checks Torob 4 times a day manually to stay in the top 3 positions; paranoid about competitors undercutting.

behaviours.name: Zhaket one-off plugin buyer
behaviours.how: Accustomed to buying lifetime GPL/Zhaket plugins for 400,000 Toman; deeply suspicious of monthly SaaS fees.

behaviours.name: Overwhelmed operator
behaviours.how: Spends evenings manually updating WooCommerce prices from supplier Telegram lists; desperately needs time back.

behaviours.name: Tech-skeptical store owner
behaviours.how: Fears plugin conflicts, site slowdowns, or an automated script destroying product prices.

behaviours.name: Wait-and-see follower
behaviours.how: Only adopts new tools after seeing colleagues or industry Telegram groups recommend them.

objections: Why pay 1,000,000 Toman every month when I can buy a one-time Zhaket plugin for 400,000 Toman?
Entering cost prices and margins for 400 products is too much manual work.
What if the bot matches the wrong product on Torob and slashes my price by 40%?
Can't I just keep checking Torob manually or have my assistant do it in Excel?
Will this plugin slow down my WooCommerce site or conflict with LiteSpeed/WP Rocket?
What happens when Torob blocks your scrapers or changes their website structure?
My suppliers don't provide clean price lists; their prices change randomly on Telegram.
habits: you check the dollar rate on Bonbast or TGJU every morning before checking shop sales
you receive supplier price updates in Telegram channels and voice notes
you check your Torob dashboard daily to see clicks and cost-per-click spend
you pack and dispatch orders between 2 PM and 5 PM every day
